MANSORA · EXPERIENCE REDESIGN

Less to navigate.
More you can get done.

A task-first design proposal for Mansora’s clients and platform team. Start a journey below to review the layouts, instructions and outcomes. All amounts and identities are illustrative.

Sell with confidenceA focused basket, clear payment, restricted discounts and an unambiguous receipt.Explore journey →Bring in your productsExcel upload, understandable row errors, review and confirmed import.Explore journey →Buy cartons. Sell units.Carton costing, selling price, margin and stock receiving stay together.Explore journey →Manage customer creditSee the customer ledger, receive repayments and review the remaining balance.Explore journey →Understand the numbersChoose a business question, see definitions and export the right period.Explore journey →Run Mansora for clientsSeparate client operations, subscriptions, collections and support consent.Explore journey →Start and get helpA guided setup and useful help that follows the task.Explore journey →Review mobile layoutsPrioritised summaries and readable product details on smaller screens.Explore journey →Handle exceptions clearlyConnection loss, failed reports and safe recovery preserve the user’s context.Explore journey →

Design review prototype only. Inputs and transitions demonstrate the proposed experience; they do not save records, upload workbooks or move money. The existing software and backend are unchanged.

1. Create the client and approved plan
